properties.displayName: OJK - Manual attestation for Implement User Identity Lifecycle Management
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Use a centralized Identity Provider (IdP) to manage the user identity lifecycle for accessing cloud systems, with continuous monitoring and periodic reviews to ensure compliance and security. (IAM-50).

metadata.Description:
"User Identity Lifecycle Management
1. When a new employee joins, HR initiates the process in the HRIS system, which triggers automated user creation in the IdP solution
2. Based on the employee's role and department, IdP solution automatically provisions access to relevant cloud resources across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud using SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management) protocol
3. IdP solution enforces Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) policies consistently across all cloud platforms
4. SSO: Employees use their identity credentials for seamless access to all cloud resources, reducing password fatigue and security risks
5. When an employee leaves, HR initiates the termination process, automatically triggering access revocation across all cloud platforms through IdP soliution
